prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: reduced efficiency. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 41.2 °C (33% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 45.7 °C (27% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 47.9 °C (23% above healthy). Thermal dissipation is sub-optimal, allowing gradual temperature elevation during continuous load cycles.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.89 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 368 W·min/l (4% below healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 6.68 l/min (within 2% of healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.3 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
